key_features: Multi-page PDF extraction with page-level snippet and provenance tracking
Strict Pydantic schema validation for numeric values, units, and dates
Relational Db2 storage with strict foreign keys and transactional rollback

Evidence-grounded Q&A backed strictly by approved Db2 records
Append-only audit logging for compliance and governance
Full adherence to medical safety boundaries (synthetic demo data only, no autonomous diagnosis)
